metadata.description: Mods for the Claude Code desktop app: a status band, session colours, a project map and a git graph

plugins.name: status-band
plugins.description: Band above the message box: context, plan limits and session cost, live; agents and background tasks; folds to one row

plugins.name: session-tint
plugins.description: Gives each session its own Tokyo Night colour: a rule above the message box (a bar on a folded status band), your prompts, the spinner and the turn's closing line; /tint changes it

plugins.name: agent-map
plugins.description: Project map panel: the components of the project's PLAN.md as cards with their tasks, and live on them which agents are working where, on which files and at what

plugins.name: git-graph
plugins.description: Git graph panel: commits as a graph with branch and tag labels, a branch filter, a find box, uncommitted changes, and confirmed git actions; /graph or the band's graph button shows it
